card.name: The 1 in calling 911
card.fires_on: The middle digit "1" in "911" when the text tells patients or caregivers to call 911 or get emergency help, mostly in opioid overdose counseling.

modes.label: 911 in overdose advice
modes.description: The middle "1" of 911 after "calling 9" in advice to caregivers about opioid overdose and respiratory depression.
modes.example: Emphasize the importance of calling 9<<1>>1 or getting emergency medical help, even

card.plain: It fires on the middle digit of 911 in advice to call emergency services after an opioid overdose.
